audit_performed_utc_note: Exact check timestamp was not recorded; these direct checks were completed earlier in this session and preserved here at the parent agent request.
scope: Independent read-only audit of saved candidate cold/cache-hit NPY outputs, material-control liveness, and five published finished-frame PNGs. No original-versus-candidate comparison.
recording_method: The direct checks below were already performed on actual saved arrays, one case/frame pair at a time. This serialization re-read receipt metadata for paths and expected hashes but did not repeat array comparisons. Hash match flags, equality results and liveness counts preserve those measured audit results.

source_provenance.source_provenance_limit: Source and settings agreement was checked from receipts; this audit did not import project modules or re-hash every source file.

execution.array_processing: One case/frame pair at a time; NumPy/cv2 only, single-thread environment and cv2.setNumThreads(0).

material_liveness.measurement_phase: cold; all corresponding cache-hit arrays were separately found exact
material_liveness.initial_depth: float32 1e9, except blocked cloth left half is 1
material_liveness.pixel_difference_definition: A pixel differs if at least one decoded RGB component differs; depth differences are exact scalar comparisons.

rough_displacement_on_vs_off.sentinel_limit: The depth maximum excludes hit/miss changes against the 1e9 miss sentinel.

film_sp_saved_masks.limit: These counts come from saved masks. Pre-SP film depth arrays were not saved, so film masks were not independently recomputed against their input depth arrays.

preview_checks.color_order: RGB; decoded OpenCV BGR converted to RGB for the comparison

limitations: This is candidate cold/cache-hit consistency, not original-versus-candidate equivalence or approval to adopt the source change.
Only repeat-zero arrays are saved for each output in each phase. Later warm repeats have receipt hashes but were not available as independent saved NPY files for this audit.
SP output RGB/depth/masks and finished full-frame RGB are separately counted; their equality claims must not be conflated.
Material masks were recomputed from known fixture initial depths; film masks were counted but could not be recomputed because pre-SP film depths were not saved.
The finite sampled material fixtures and five frames do not prove equivalence across all scenes, seeds, camera positions or production frames.
No render, compilation, timing experiment, artistic judgment or original-reference comparison was performed by this audit.
The study uses the recorded 61cf28b base and excludes later PR8 catch changes.
